component.name: Eclipse
component.summary: Moonlight game streaming client with an enhanced in-session control center

description.p: Eclipse streams games from compatible Sunshine and GameStream hosts. It includes an in-session control center, optional FSR scaling, stream profiles, performance statistics, and direct recording of supported video and audio streams.
Add optional Vulkan Mailbox presentation with FIFO fallback, disable recording while client FSR is active, and clarify and regroup settings.
Add guest input permissions and view-only mode, adaptive bitrate controls for Sunshine hosts, and direct-to-Desktop launch.
Add Flatpak packaging and in-stream recording for H.264, HEVC, or AV1 video with Opus audio.
